The rental terms, insurance and the machine's suitability must be confirmed directly with the rental operator and the local club.

candidatesAccepted.title: Chicoutimi to Alma groomed link
candidatesAccepted.summary: A groomed-trail leg from the Saguenay into the Lac-Saint-Jean area, kept short enough for riders new to the machine. Not answered: destination, ages, access needs, and whether this trail is groomed in January or February. The two riders who have never ridden should get a tighter route than the two experienced riders would choose.

candidatesAccepted.title: Chicoutimi to Roberval lakeside run
candidatesAccepted.summary: A longer groomed run toward Roberval on the lake side, offering a flatter ride for mixed skill levels. Not answered: destination, ages, access needs, and rider limits. Trail condition, grooming schedule, and rental-machine suitability for four riders are unchecked, so this is a possibility, not a confirmed route.

candidatesAccepted.title: Saguenay valley to Tadoussac groomed run
candidatesAccepted.summary: A scenic groomed-trail option linking the Saguenay valley with the Tadoussac area, aimed at the demanding effort level. Not answered: destination, ages, access needs, and the stated rule-out conditions. I could not confirm that a continuous groomed trail covers this whole stretch, so the party should verify it before relying on it.

candidatesAccepted.title: Groomed-trail inn at Saint-Félicien
candidatesAccepted.summary: A simple inn near Saint-Félicien, reachable from Saguenay, that suits a party where two riders are new to snowmobiles and the group prefers groomed trails to off-trail riding. I could not account for the destination, the ages, the access needs or what would rule the trip out, since those were not answered, so this is a proposal only and not clearance to go anywhere. Rental machine range is 180 km between stops, which I have not checked against this location.

candidatesAccepted.title: Simple lodge at Saint-Prime
candidatesAccepted.summary: A basic lodge option near Saint-Prime on Lac-Saint-Jean, offering a plain night for a party of four with a mix of riding experience. Destination, ages, access needs and rule-out conditions were not answered, so I could not check those fits, and the cost band is my estimate, not a quote.

candidatesAccepted.title: Groomed-trail snowmobile riding from Saguenay
candidatesAccepted.summary: Matches the party's preference for fewer kilometres on groomed trail over off-trail riding, and suits the two riders with a season behind them. The two who have never ridden should start on the easiest groomed section. Destination was not answered, so this is placed at Saguenay as the departure point. Ages, access needs and what would rule the trip out were not answered and I have not accounted for them.

candidatesAccepted.title: Guided groomed-trail snowmobile outing
candidatesAccepted.summary: A guide would reduce the risk for the two riders with no experience while keeping the groomed-trail pace the party asked for. Duration, cost, season and booking lead time were not checked, so they are left unknown.

candidatesAccepted.title: Frozen-lake ice fishing break
candidatesAccepted.summary: A low-effort stop away from the machines for the two who have not ridden. Whether a suitable lake is reachable depends on the destination, which was not answered, so availability is unknown.

candidatesAccepted.title: Groomed-trail loop from Saint-Félicien
candidatesAccepted.summary: A groomed snowmobile trail network suits the wish for fewer kilometres on groomed trail rather than off-trail, and it works for riders who have not ridden before as well as for those with a season behind them. The destination was not answered, so this is a proposal, not a chosen place, and the ages, access needs and rule-outs were not answered either. I have not checked trail grooming, snow depth or closures for January to February 2027, and the 180 km range between stops is not checked against this network. Trail status and closures must come from the local snowmobile club and the Fédération des clubs de motoneigistes du Québec, not from this list.

candidatesAccepted.title: Lac-Saint-Jean groomed lake and trail crossing
candidatesAccepted.summary: A groomed route across the frozen lake area around Roberval and Alma offers open, well-marked riding for a mixed-experience group who want to stay on groomed surfaces. Nothing here is checked for the dates given, and the lake-ice safety conditions are unknown to me, so they must be confirmed with the local club and the relevant municipal or regional authority before anyone rides on the ice. The destination and rule-outs were not answered, so this is one option among several.

candidatesAccepted.title: Saguenay-side groomed trail hub near La Baie
candidatesAccepted.summary: A trail hub on the Saguenay side keeps the riding on groomed routes and may suit the riders still building experience. The ride distances and grooming frequency have not been checked against the 180 km range, and the ages, access needs and the rough-night limit beyond simple are unknown to me. Confirm trail status and the rental machine's suitability with the local club before committing.

candidatesAccepted.title: Rental orientation and gear check at a local club base
candidatesAccepted.summary: For the two riders who have not ridden at all, a short orientation on the rental machine and a gear check before any trail riding would reduce the risk the group is carrying. This is an option, not a clearance to ride, and I have not verified whether a given club offers such a session or when. The rental terms, insurance and the machine's suitability must be confirmed directly with the rental operator and the local club.

candidatesAccepted.title: Snowmobile rental pickup and fitting in Saguenay
candidatesAccepted.summary: Two of the four have never ridden, so a rental collected and fitted before leaving Saguenay is worth doing. I could not account for the destination, the ages, the access needs or what would rule the trip out, so this is a starting point only and not clearance to travel anywhere.

candidatesAccepted.title: Groomed-trail access permit for the party
candidatesAccepted.summary: Riding only groomed trails, as the party asked, usually means buying a trail access pass that covers each rider. I did not check the current pass terms or which networks they cover, and the destination is unanswered, so the pass needed depends on where the group goes.

candidatesAccepted.title: Rental insurance and deductible check
candidatesAccepted.summary: Rented machines often carry a deductible and exclusions that matter with novice riders. I did not confirm the terms for this operator, and I could not account for the access needs or ages, which may change what cover is needed.

Nothing was checked about where to eat.
